chunks.head: a great deal of
chunks.note: a great deal of + 不可数名词 = 大量的。

literal.note_cn: 此处指'数量',非'交易/处理'义

chunks.ex_en: She spends a great deal of time reading.

chunks.head: lay up
chunks.note: lay up = 把…储存起来备用。
chunks.ex_en: Squirrels lay up nuts for the winter.

chunks.head: in order to
chunks.note: in order to + 动词原形 = 为了做某事。

literal.note_cn: 此处指'目的',非'命令/次序'义

chunks.ex_en: He saves money in order to buy a bike.
chunks.ex_cn: 他存钱是为了买自行车。

chunks.head: on shore
chunks.note: on shore = 在陆地上(相对于在船上或海里)。
chunks.ex_en: The sailors went on shore to rest.

chunks.head: by far
chunks.gloss: …得多、明显地(与比较级/最高级连用)
chunks.note: by far 强调差距很大,常修饰 the best/the worst 等。

literal.note_cn: 此处表'程度差距',非'被/靠'义

chunks.ex_en: This is by far the best cake I've eaten.
chunks.ex_cn: 这是我吃过最好吃的蛋糕。

chunks.head: by any means
chunks.gloss: (常与否定连用)决不、无论如何也(不)
chunks.note: not … by any means = 决不、无论如何都不。
chunks.ex_en: He would not agree by any means.
chunks.ex_cn: 他无论如何都不会同意。

chunks.head: more or less
chunks.note: more or less = 差不多、几乎(表约略)。
chunks.ex_en: The work is more or less finished.

chunks.head: by degrees
chunks.note: by degrees = 循序渐进地、慢慢地。

chunks.head: stick close to
chunks.gloss: 紧挨着、紧靠;守着不离开
chunks.note: stick close to = 紧贴/紧跟着某人或某处不离开。
chunks.ex_en: Stick close to me in the crowd.

chunks.head: take care to
chunks.gloss: 注意去(做)、特意小心地(做)
chunks.note: take care to do = 特意、小心地去做某事。
chunks.ex_en: She takes care to lock the door every night.

chunks.head: to my advantage
chunks.note: to one's advantage = 对某人有利、于某人有益。
chunks.ex_en: The new rule works to my advantage.

chunks.head: so much as
chunks.note: not so much as … = 连…都不、甚至没有。
chunks.ex_en: He left without so much as a goodbye.
chunks.ex_cn: 他连再见都没说就走了。

chunks.head: content oneself with
chunks.note: content oneself with = 满足于现有的,不再多求。

literal.note_cn: 此处为动词,非形容词'满意的'

chunks.ex_en: I contented myself with a cup of tea.
